player_prompt.intro:
Kedda d-iklan {player_id} ({piece}). Imɣad d- ({opp}).
Sekkraḍ tirawas s umur '[a2 a3]' (zag → ɣer).
- Tirawt tamagnut d tin yiwen n ugraw s azag n uɣbalu ur igaddan.
- Asɣab d tin n uɣiwel n uɣbalu n uɣen yirɣan s azag n uɣbalu ur igaddan.
Kull asɣab ittaws {score_per_capture} imuraren.
Urir ittɣama s {max_moves} tirawasen neɣ mi d-iklan war tirawt tamagnut.

outcome.no_pieces: ⴰⵎⵓⵔⴰⵔ {player_id} ⵓⵔ ⵢⴰⵍⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⴱⵔⵉⴷⵜ.
